title: Valarie Allman Wins Every 2025 Diamond League Meet
excerpt: Valarie Allman won every Diamond League discus competition she entered in 2025, only the eighth athlete to do so. Here are all the perfect seasons so far.
body:
Valarie Allman won every Diamond League discus competition she entered in 2025: Xiamen, Rome, Paris and Eugene, then the Final in Zurich, where she threw 69.18 m. It secured her fifth consecutive Diamond Trophy. "She is only the eighth athlete ever to win every single Diamond League competition in one season," the Diamond League wrote in January 2026.

A "perfect season" means winning every Diamond League competition in a single season. Results at meetings outside the Diamond League don't count.

Every perfect Diamond League season

  • Valerie Adams (shot put): 2010, 7 of 7, when the series was known as the Diamond Race. She did it again in 2014.
  • Sandra Elkasević (discus): 2013, 7 of 7.
  • Mariya Lasitskene (high jump): 2017, 7 of 7, clearing 2 m in every competition.
  • Caterine Ibargüen (triple jump): 2018, 5 of 5.
  • Daniel Ståhl (discus): 2021, all four competitions. He was the first man to do it.
  • Kristjan Čeh (discus): 2022, including a Diamond League record of 71.27 m in Birmingham.
  • Chase Jackson (shot put, then competing as Chase Ealey): 2022, all five competitions. 2022 is the only year two athletes swept their event.
  • Valarie Allman (discus): 2025.

Who could do it in 2026

The Diamond League named several contenders. Mondo Duplantis won seven of his eight Diamond League competitions in 2025. Femke Bol has been unbeaten in 30 Diamond League 400m hurdles races since 2020, but is expected to move to the 800m in 2026. Mykolas Alekna won three of the last four competitions in 2025 and broke Čeh's Diamond League record in London.

What it means for your running

Winning every meeting in a season is rare even for the world's best. For most runners, the more useful goal is a season of consistent training: weeks that are good enough, repeated, rather than a few perfect weeks followed by a break.

Track your training week by week for a month, and look at the pattern rather than at individual sessions.

Source: Wanda Diamond League: Chasing the perfect Diamond League season
keyTakeaway: A perfect season is rare even for the world's best; for most runners, consistent weeks of good-enough training are the realistic goal.
